findings.title: Unanchored Floating POI Markers
findings.where: City screen, circular area over building models
findings.problem: Bright color-coded chevron icons float randomly in space above buildings without shadows, ground rings, or stems connecting them to structures.
findings.why: Destroys visual depth in top-down view, making it hard to tell which icon corresponds to which building or interaction point.
findings.fix: Replace floating chevrons with ground-projected colored pads or vertical waypoint pins anchored directly to building entrances with drop shadows.

findings.title: Abstract Blueprint Vehicle Preview
findings.problem: The vehicle visual preview is a primitive wireframe box with two grey rectangles instead of showing the actual vehicle model.
findings.why: Deprives the player of visual satisfaction during customization and fails to show armor coverage or weapon mounting locations on the vehicle body.
findings.fix: Replace the static vector outline with a top-down sprite or WebGPU preview model of the selected car chassis that updates visually when armor and weapons are attached.

findings.title: Ground Texture Pixelation and Artifacts
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, ground and pavement surfaces
findings.problem: The ground surfaces exhibit severe blocky texture compression noise and pixelated seams mixed with smooth grid lines.
findings.why: Creates visual clutter around the player vehicle and makes the WebGPU rendering pipeline look broken or unfinished.
findings.fix: Use seamless, properly mipmapped terrain textures with uniform detail density and smooth normal blending instead of noisy compressed rasters.

findings.title: Misplaced Arcade Debug Widget
findings.problem: An isolated 'Arcade' pill button floats alone in the top-left margin, separated entirely from the main menu panel in the lower left.
findings.why: Reads as a temporary developer debug button rather than professional main-menu interface design, ruining composition balance.
findings.fix: Move game mode selection into the main lower-left menu list directly above or alongside 'New Driver'.

findings.title: Non-Functional Radar Display
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left Radar panel
findings.problem: The radar widget is an indistinct dark circle with a static triangle, lacking visible range rings, cardinal markings, or active contact sweeps.
findings.why: Fails to communicate spatial awareness or threat directions at speed, reading like an inactive decorative graphic.
findings.fix: Add crisp concentric distance rings, clear cardinal direction markers, a dynamic radar sweep effect, and high-contrast contact blips.
